2) Can Redwood bridge unused onboarding credits (from our Acct A allocation) into a short-term dedicated discount for the pilot (6–8 weeks)? Sponsor will cover the difference but needs a line-item showing Redwood provided the credit bridge.

3) Timeline: cohort starts July 12. We need confirmation of any exception by July 5 to get internal approvals.

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. Quick answers / next steps from our side:

- High-level: we can typically not transfer promo credits across accounts, but we do have a one-time "cohort swap" carveout for sponsored pilots when there is documented sponsor funding and an expected ARR path. I need to confirm a small set of guardrails with finance/legal (cc'd Laura).

- Proposed immediate concession (pending approvals): convert up to $15k of unused onboarding credits from Acct A into a one-time pilot credit that can be applied to Acct B for a 6-week pilot. We would show this in an SOW addendum and a short credit memo for your sponsor.

- Seat reallocation: we can allow seats to be moved between the two cohort accounts for the pilot window, provided both accounts accept the standard pilot terms and agree to the same MSA addendum.

Can you confirm the exact dollar amount you want moved (or I can align to the workbook totals)? Also, please confirm the sponsor legal contact for the DocuSign route — our approval is timeboxed so July 5 is doable if finance gives the green light today.

Proposed MAP milestone: 
  1) Today (7/1): confirm requested credit amount and legal contact
  2) 7/2: Redwood finance sign-off + draft SOW addendum
  3) 7/3: DocuSign complete
  4) 7/5: credit applied and seats reassigned

I attached a short MAP PDF for clarity. If this works I will escalate to Ben for the policy exception.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
